title: Bounty Hunters
synopsis: On a lawless alien planet where the Wild West meets science fiction, bounty hunters Bublik and Tubik are chased across the desert by a gang of outlaws on hoverbikes — only to find gigantic sandworms waiting beneath the sand.

audienceReactions.quote: Absolutely brilliant! A wild mix of Mad Max, Dune, A-Team, Tremors, and Doomsday making for a wonderful blend of humor and satire.
audienceReactions.author: YouTube viewer

audienceReactions.quote: I love the work and the concept, the action has some holes, but good stuff.
audienceReactions.author: YouTube viewer

audienceReactions.quote: Like the idea and concept, but it would've been better if it was actually animated instead of using AI.
